cases.estimand: A weighted Gaussian intensity or normalized mass evaluated on an explicit rectangular grid.
conventions: native sigma is standard deviation; pinned MASS divides its argument by four
native cell-centre binned truncated kernel differs from continuous backend grids
uniform and explicit duration weights; explicit R weights take precedence over duration weighting
R duration_weighted defaults differ by entry point
R window filtering precedes minimum count two
type-7 IQR rule and explicit display clamp
native group processing retains typed failures
cases.independent_case: A 5 by 3 non-square grid with reversed explicit weights detects axis, weighting, normalization and edge-policy mistakes.
cases.divergence: Native weighted discrete Gaussian and source-edge correction are qualified by a direct 2-D discrete oracle at 1e-12, not claimed identical to continuous ks/MASS. MASS unweighted agrees with independent continuous Gaussian at fixed 1e-7 rounding tolerance; ks direct-evaluation differences are retained. Pinned explicit weights are honoured and weighted MASS agrees with a direct weighted continuous Gaussian at the same 1e-7 tolerance. R density_by drops failed groups; native errors remain operands. IQR suggestion agrees for valid positive outputs; singleton/zero unbounded sigma is a typed error, not NA/zero bandwidth.

cases.estimand: Normalized surface value at the nearest sampled grid coordinate (rounded interpolated index), with edge clamping, for each requested fixation coordinate.
conventions: evaluation is deterministic and is not random sampling
coordinate-to-index interpolation then R round; density values are not bilinearly interpolated
finite outside coordinates clamp via approx rule=2; missing coordinates remain missing
output cardinality matches query cardinality or reports failures
cases.independent_case: Two inside and two outside queries distinguish interpolation, clipping and partial indexing.
cases.divergence: Named nearest/clamped one-based-even-index lookup agrees on identical cell-centre coordinates, including normalization and shared fast trajectory composition. Existing containing-cell/outside-missing semantics remain a separate policy. Z-scored output is Signed. Exactly constant fields remain raw; singleton native z-score remains raw while pinned R errors. Nonfinite queries/arithmetic yield located or typed failures.
